thread:
priya: small RFC follow-up : proposing a "micro-canary" pattern for low-traffic routes — use a request budget B (req/min) rather than pure percent. want quick tradeoffs + heuristics.
jason: budget is neat. two immediate Qs: how do we pick probes to cover surface area, and how do we compute confidence with small N?
maria: agree on confidence issue. suggest Bayesian priors for error rate + Thompson sampling for deciding if the canary is probably worse. that avoids hard thresholds when N tiny.
priya: exactly. controller uses a Beta prior for error-rate and updates with observed errs. rollback if posterior Pr(err_canary > err_baseline + delta) > p_abort.
lia: probe selection: reservoir sample up to K probes per minute, with min_probe_diversity to force distinct user buckets. stash examples for ops.
jason: runtime enforcement: two-stage: 1) allocate B via lightweight token-bucket; 2) decisions by sticky-hash for streaming. token-bucket decides which requests count toward budget, hashing decides variant when chosen.
maria: add retry policy on transient network errors so they don't bias stats. also normalize for request size if cost correlates with latency.
opsbot: [bot] canary run 1844000000 summary: budget_peak=40rpm, p95_delta=+9ms, err_delta=0.12% https://deployments/redwood/1844000000
priya: state machine: PRECHECK -> DRY_PROBE -> MICRO_LIVE -> ASSESS -> ROLLBACK/GRADUAL. DRY_PROBE runs replay or synthetic probes; only succeed -> MICRO_LIVE.
lia: UX: Console shows budget bar (B used / B total), probe-sample carousel, posterior probability gauge for "is canary worse?", and fast actions: [Pause Auto] [Force Advance] [Open Preflight].
jason: statistical detail: use hierarchical prior per-route-class so tiny routes borrow strength from similar endpoints. also report credible intervals, not p-values.
maria: ops playbook: if posterior crosses p_abort then pause + human review; if it crosses p_rollback immediately then rollback with a cooldown. include run_id and probe examples in Slack.
priya: policy sketch (signed): route, variant, budget_per_min, min_probe_diversity, priors_id, p_abort, p_rollback, retry_policy, fallback_variant, run_id. controller <-> runtime via signed push; telemetry batched per-window.
lia: need to define privacy rules for replayed probes. by default redact PII and require customer opt-in for replay.
priya: open items: choose default priors, pick K and min_probe_diversity defaults, simulate on low-traffic endpoints. jason/maria/lia to prototype stats + Console snippet. reconvene next week. end thread.
